mechanism: Replace only particle Adam second moment by EMA of squared gradients averaged across particle rows, retaining row gradients and original beta1/beta2, bias correction, epsilon and LR schedule. No clipping. Global coordinate-wise scale transports low-gradient particles without permanently private denominators.
rationale: Prior displacement clipping loses rare mass; shared moments retain gradient magnitude and relative mobility without isolated row accumulators.
optimizer_updates: One D plus one G/particle update per frozen iteration; particle custom update substitutes original Adam table update.
extra_work: O(N*d) square and reduction and broadcast; equal-step only, not exact equal-compute.
